gameDescriptionHtml:
Fluffy Sailors is a charming action-roguelite where you fight in thrilling real-time sea battles between adorable animal pirates. Fire them at your enemies, capture their ships, and fulfill Her Majesty’s royal mission!

What are you waiting for? The Mouse Queen has chosen you as her champion! Set sail and rescue the royal cook. Nobody likes bad food. Nobody.

Game Features

  • Thrilling sea battles with animal ships! – In a world of spherical, fluffy animals, you set sail to rescue the Mouse Queen’s cook from the clutches of the alligators. You will encounter challenging sea battles, picturesque island landscapes, and ships that only exist in a world of fluffy animal pirates.
  • Learn from your mistakes – Not everyone is as infallible as the Mouse Queen! After a defeat, you return to the Mouse Kingdom to improve your skills and make another attempt. Keep getting stronger until you can rule the seas!
  • Discover unique animal factions and ship types! – When your enemies surrender, you can add them to your fleet and benefit from their different designs and strengths!
